GHAR SAJAG — ENGINEERING / TECHNICIAN LIVE DIAGNOSTICS DASHBOARD
DESIGN-ONLY TASK
Do not implement code.Do not modify files.Do not create commits.Do not change product behavior.
Your job is to study the existing Ghar Sajag repository and produce a detailed implementation-ready design for an Engineering / Technician Diagnostics Dashboard.
Design a technician-facing diagnostics capability for:
first-time Hub and ESP32-C3 node installation;

commissioning and placement validation;

live field troubleshooting;

identifying whether a failure is in:
sensor/node;

ESP-NOW transport;

Hub;

journal/persistence;

Wi-Fi/backend;

web/PWA delivery.


This is separate from the normal caregiver/family dashboard.
The technician should not need to read raw firmware logs for routine troubleshooting.
Conceptually:
ESP32-C3 Node-> ESP-NOW-> ESP32 Hub-> Hub processing/journal-> backend-> PWA
The engineering dashboard must observe and explain this existing flow.
Do not propose a duplicate event-processing pipeline unless absolutely necessary.
Diagnostic test controls may be separate, but real product events should stay on the normal production path.
Reuse existing telemetry, protocol state, persistence, simulator and APIs wherever possible.

Do not redesign unrelated product architecture.

Do not weaken production security or authentication.

Keep caregiver/family UX separate from engineering diagnostics.

Prefer human-readable troubleshooting over raw logs.

Preserve existing event/session/sequence semantics.

Clearly distinguish:
product events;

transport diagnostics;

system diagnostics.


Do not invent telemetry that the firmware cannot currently measure.

If a metric is unavailable, identify what instrumentation would be required.

Inspect the existing implementation before proposing a design.
Identify:
Hub modules

ESP32-C3 node modules

ESP-NOW transport implementation

event structures

heartbeat logic

association/session handling

sequence numbering

ACK/retry handling

deduplication

journal/persistence

backend upload path

outbox/queue behavior

web/PWA data model

simulator

test framework

authorization model

current diagnostics/logging

existing HIL controls

existing admin/settings pages

For every proposed capability, state whether it is:
A. already available;B. partially available;C. missing;D. available only in logs;E. available only in simulation/HIL.
Do not assume.
Design a technician overview showing:
Hub:
online/offline

firmware version

uptime

Wi-Fi status

backend connectivity

last successful backend synchronization

Nodes:
node ID

assigned room/zone

online/offline

firmware version

battery voltage / percentage if available

last heartbeat

last event

association/session state

current health

Recommended health states:
HEALTHYWARNINGOFFLINECOMMISSIONINGERROR
Define exact rules for each status.
Avoid arbitrary thresholds unless existing implementation already defines them.
Design a chronological live diagnostic stream.
Separate events into:
A. PRODUCT EVENTS
MOTION

DOOR_OPEN

DOOR_CLOSE

HEARTBEAT

B. TRANSPORT DIAGNOSTICS
TX

RX

ACK

C. SYSTEM DIAGNOSTICS

For each record, determine which fields already exist and which must be added.
Candidate fields:
event_id

zone_id

session_id

sequence_number

event_type

hub_timestamp

node_timestamp or uptime

retry_count

transport result

journal state

backend delivery state

Do not require every field for every record.
Design a readable trace for a selected event:
Sensor triggeredNode event createdESP-NOW transmittedHub receivedHub validatedHub persistedRules processedBackend queuedBackend deliveredDashboard received
Each stage should have:
PASSWARNINGFAILUNKNOWNNOT_APPLICABLE
Example:
Bathroom PIRMotion detected
Node event created PASSESP-NOW TX PASSHub RX PASSJournal persisted PASSBackend delivered FAIL
Reason:Backend unreachable
The UI should explain where the chain stopped.
Determine how each stage can be proven using current event IDs, session IDs, sequence numbers and existing logs/state.
If correlation is currently insufficient, define the smallest additional correlation mechanism.
Design a device detail page showing:
node ID

zone

firmware version

uptime

battery

RSSI

last heartbeat

last product event

current session ID

latest sequence number

retry counters

duplicate counters

failure counters

last reconnect/rejoin

Possible technician actions:
Send Test Event

Identify Node

Refresh Status

Restart Device

Recommission Node

For each action specify:
whether support already exists;

where the command should originate;

how it should be authenticated;

expected response;

timeout;

failure behavior;

whether it is safe in production.

Do not expose signing keys or security material.
Design Node -> Hub diagnostics for:
RSSI

retries

ACK failures

last successful RX

last successful ACK

communication age

channel info if available

Design Hub -> Backend diagnostics for:
Wi-Fi state

Wi-Fi RSSI

backend reachability

pending outbox depth

oldest queued event

last successful upload

last upload error

Only propose:
packet loss percentage;

latency;

average RSSI;

trend data;

if the system currently has enough measurements to calculate them reliably.
Otherwise state the instrumentation required.
Design a guided installer workflow.
Example:
Validate Hub

Validate Room1 node

Validate Kitchen node

Validate Bathroom node

Validate Main Door node

Validate backend delivery

For a PIR:
"Trigger Room1 PIR"
System waits for the correct node/event and then shows:
PASSNode C3-01RSSI -57 dBmHub RX PASSBackend delivery PASS
For a door sensor:
"Open the main door"

Define:

retry;

wrong-node handling;

duplicate handling;

offline handling;

backend-offline handling;

Final per-device states:

Design diagnostics so a technician can answer questions like:
Is the node powered?

Is it associated?

Is the Hub receiving it?

Is the node retrying?

Is the Hub ACKing?

Is the event being deduplicated?

For common failures, propose operator-friendly explanations.
Example:
"Node is sending but Hub is not acknowledging."

Determine how the current simulator can support the engineering dashboard.

The same frontend/API contract should work against simulated and real devices.
Avoid a simulator-only UI.
Design authorization for technician diagnostics.
Separate:
READ_DIAGNOSTICS
from privileged actions such as:
DEVICE_RESTARTDEVICE_RECOMMISSIONTEST_CONTROL

Define:

signing keys;

Propose the minimum additional schemas needed.

Do not treat these example names as mandatory.
First examine current API style and follow existing conventions.
For every endpoint define:
purpose

response

auth

data source

Analyze:
Hub RAM impact

Hub flash/NVS impact

C3 RAM/flash impact

radio overhead

backend storage

PWA memory

diagnostic event volume

Avoid continuously streaming unnecessary raw logs.
Recommend retention levels such as:
short live window;

bounded recent diagnostics;

longer-lived installation result;

aggregated health history.

Provide approximate sizing where the current system provides enough inputs.
Clearly mark assumptions.
Define diagnostic categories such as:
NODE_OFFLINEWEAK_RADIOASSOCIATION_FAILUREACK_TIMEOUTEXCESSIVE_RETRYDUPLICATE_EVENTHUB_STORAGE_FAILUREBACKEND_OFFLINEBACKEND_QUEUE_GROWINGCONFIG_MISMATCH
For each category provide:

Design automated coverage for:

heartbeat expiry

RSSI update

product event trace

ACK/retry visibility

duplicate handling

backend offline

outbox backlog

reboot/rejoin

installation PASS

installation FAIL

wrong node triggered

timeout

technician authorization

event correlation

Identify:

simulator tests

Do not modify the existing validation framework during this design task.
Propose implementation in small stages.
Example structure:

# 2026-10-13 — PRODUCT-OWNER DECISION: ED-D01 APPROVED (BOUNDED READ-ONLY ARCHITECTURE ONLY)

**AUTHORITATIVE JIRA APPROVAL UPDATE — SUPERSEDES THE ED-D01=PENDING STATEMENT IN GS-120 COMMENT 10624 AND THE ORIGINAL 2026-10-12 ARCHITECTURE PACKAGE.** User explicitly approved ED-D01 after independent review. This approves the _named design direction_ below, NOT unapproved security, privacy, storage, target telemetry, installation certification, or production-release claims. Other ED-D02–ED-D09 retain separate gates. No code was implemented, merged or executed by this Jira decision.

## Decision identity, reviewed evidence and boundary

* **ID:** ED-D01. **State:** APPROVED — `READ_ONLY_ARCHITECTURE_SUBSET`; decision recorded 2026-10-13 based on user's explicit approval in this ChatGPT review.
* **Design/version:** `GS120_ENGINEERING_DASHBOARD_ARCHITECTURE.md` v1, 2026-10-12, [committed document](https://github.com/udaybhan200683/Ghar_sajag/blob/31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2/docs/architecture/GS120_ENGINEERING_DASHBOARD_ARCHITECTURE.md).
* **Delivery:** branch `feature/gs124-125-engineering-dashboard`, isolated worktree `/home/udaybhan/projects/Ghar_sajag_r1_dashboard`, source commit `31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2` remote-reported verified, base `77e29d44c57f0851f78358049c288323c985d2e7`.
* **Review:** [GS-122 delivery](https://github.com/udaybhan200683/Ghar_sajag/blob/31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2/docs/exec-plans/evidence/engineering_dashboard_20261012/GS122_DELIVERY_SUMMARY.md); [decisions and blockers](https://github.com/udaybhan200683/Ghar_sajag/blob/31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2/docs/exec-plans/evidence/engineering_dashboard_20261012/OPEN_DECISIONS_AND_BLOCKERS.md); [resume instructions](https://github.com/udaybhan200683/Ghar_sajag/blob/31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2/docs/exec-plans/evidence/engineering_dashboard_20261012/CAMPAIGN_HANDOFF.md).
* **Evidence class:** 45 preparation tests (37 draft model + 8 actual local file-backed backend durable-API), 20 inactive static browser checks, existing host 8 groups/325 checks and existing readiness 29 API/policy + 39 framework + 17 no-port HIL test checks. These qualify isolated preparation only; they DO NOT qualify a live production diagnostic API, technician authentication, actual field sensor, browser authorization, HIL or full product release.

## Architectural conclusions accepted under ED-D01

1. **Observe, never own, product behavior.** Existing PIR/C3→authenticated ESP-NOW→S3 admission, journal/application durable-before-ACK, CloudSync, backend, caregiver PWA remain original source of truth. Diagnostic projection consumes read-only committed/product-owned observations, not a second product event pipeline, product ACK/retire/replay owner, rules engine, cloud receipt authority or consumer-triggered CloudSync worker.
2. **Use original identity and explicit provenance.** A single diagnostic trace joins unmodified physical Node, logical Node, original EventKey `(origin_session_id,event_sequence)`, enrollment generation, Home/owner epoch and evidence-gated mapping. Source Node-local `room:10:1` vs qualified canonical `p6:devicen4:rooms10q1` is a mapping (not byte-equal keys). Session, sequence, room-at-occurrence, immutable original payload, dedupe/retirement semantics stay intact. Preserve exact integer identity strings across C++ uint64 / backend signed64 / JS safe integer boundaries; do not widen backend contract silently.
3. **Proof per stage, no reverse inference.** The ten conceptual trace stages: sensor triggered; Node event created; radio TX; Hub RX; Hub authenticated validation; Hub persisted; rules processed; backend queued; backend durable committed; dashboard/browser observed, plus distinct app ACK and Node retirement observations. Each stage emits PASS/WARNING/FAIL/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE with producer/environment/time/clock/source fingerprint, diagnostic reason and evidence ID. A backend row does not prove the exact optical edge, Hub durable commit, Node ACK or browser/push delivery; missing target exporter remains UNKNOWN. MAC TX success ≠ Hub receive ≠ Hub application ACK. Duplicate attempts remain one original business event, not multiple caregiver effects.
4. **Separate observation, inference and safety.** Show measured RSSI direction, NodeHealth age vs authenticated contact age vs last product event; contact does NOT prove sensor coverage or person identity. Use existing actual GS-40 profile (default NodeHealth 300s, 910s contact lease; trusted legacy60 190s and legacy120 310s), not stale universal 190s. Source unavailable/profile unknown ⇒ UNKNOWN, not OFFLINE/HEALTHY speculation. Backend connectivity freshness is a separate axis. No fabricated battery, coverage, latency or packet-loss figures.
5. **Accept seven read-only user-experience designs:** Installation Overview; Live Events; Event Trace; Device Diagnostics; Communication Health; Guided Installation Test _display/state-machine proposal only_; Advanced Diagnostics. Bounded live view, filters, explicit freshness/gaps, accessible mobile/desktop, redaction, no caregiver screen regression or sensitive service-worker caching.
6. **Bounded compatibility-first projection interfaces:** versioned `DiagnosticEvent`/health/transport observation with optional unavailable fields and Home/ownership provenance; diagnostic observation ID is NOT original Node EventKey. Backend Home-scoped GET overview/events/trace/device/communication concepts under existing `/v1/homes/{home_id}` conventions; no raw logs, arbitrary browser ingestion, active production endpoint or role grant implied. Candidate module ownership `backend/ghar_sajag/diagnostics.py`, `frontend/src/features/engineering/`, existing product and GS-116/130 test owners. Exact method/schema is design-level, not silently approved wire/API deployment.
7. **Guided installer semantics accepted conceptually:** immutable exact expected Home/physical Node/logical Node/enrollment generation/room/sensor kind, armed cursor/attempt, fresh actual event after arming, wrong-device reject, stale retry/backlog reject, incomplete/unknown cannot PASS, required backend evidence distinct from local commit; keep prior attempts and don't convert a simulated/user-triggered test into physical qualification. Actual PASS deadline, required stage policy, manifest and durable installer certificate need ED-D04/03 before production.
8. **Resource discipline:** best-effort, bounded diagnostic buffering and server queries, drop/gap reporting rather than blocking radio, application ACK or storage; no Node wake/radio change and no new Hub journal/NVS/partition/CloudSync persistence in ED-D01. Report's 256 observations × <=512 encoded bytes, <=100 page, 5-second example poll and proposed 32 compact Hub observations are candidate estimates, NOT approved production limits or capacity measurements. Secure least-privilege Home projection and stored-data privacy must precede live activation.

## Outstanding ED-D02–ED-D09 — ALL STILL PENDING (do not imply approval)

* **ED-D02 (CRITICAL) technician auth:** verified actor and Home-scoped explicit `READ_DIAGNOSTICS`, issuer/trust middleware, expiry/revocation/ownership epoch and cross-Home deny. Existing `IdentityService.require` treats new unknown action like generic read; **never call it with READ_DIAGNOSTICS without first implementing/approving explicit deny-by-default enum/policy**. Fixture headers/actor flags and local test grant are NOT commercial authentication.
* **ED-D03 privacy/retention/export:** diagnostic allowlist, personally sensitive event exposure, ephemeral versus persistent window and installation-result retention/erasure require separate product/privacy decision. No durable installer certificate/export in ED-D01.
* **ED-D04 installation policy:** exact mandatory stages, deadlines, actual-device manifest, acceptable occurrence freshness and PASS evidence policy unapproved.
* **ED-D05 authenticated target export and budget:** GS-65/148 own real Node/Hub stage-export/telemetry source; no active deployed exporter exists. Existing S3 storage schema may not be modified concurrently.
* **ED-D06 fixture:** GS-114 reset/replay-fence NO-GO; HIL physical board, real PIR and product vertical remain BLOCKED/NOT_RUN unless separately approved compatible disposable fixture and no-state-loss observation plan.
* **ED-D07 privileged controls:** Identify/Test/Restart/Recommission commands, authority/CSRF/confirmation and audit policies excluded and remain disabled; GS-109/143 control path decision.
* **ED-D08 production CloudSync:** credentials, authenticated Hub ownership, exact committed reply, live worker/deployment and backend trust still GS-148/109 owners; local SQLite fixture evidence is not deployed production PASS.
* **ED-D09 integration:** inspect latest actual canonical HEAD/current GS-148 exclusive writes, source and validation registry changes, reconcile isolated branch, and authorize merge separately. No canonical merge, rebase, push or file overwrite authorized by ED-D01.

## Implementation/resume consequence — exact interpretation

**ED-D01 approval clears only the prior** `BLOCKED_DESIGN_APPROVAL` label for the named architecture direction. It DOES NOT remove `BLOCKED_ED_D02_AUTH` for any production technician route/role/browser view, `BLOCKED_ED_D03_PRIVACY` for protected fields/storage/export, `BLOCKED_ED_D04_POLICY` for installer PASS, `BLOCKED_ED_D05_EXPORT` for target evidence, `BLOCKED_ED_D08_CLOUD` for production cloud and `BLOCKED_ED_D09_INTEGRATION` for canonical changes. Safe inactive host-prototype/test work on the existing isolated dashboard branch is permitted only within the previous scoped campaign; production activation awaits the relevant approvals and separate implementation execution authorization. Do not auto-promote GS-124/125/122 to Done or issue a physical GO.

When Codex resumes, READ THIS APPROVAL FIRST alongside the original full design/decision register and GS-122 handoff. Do NOT redo the completed 45/20 preparation campaign or 325 host checks without changed affected source. Confirm exact current branch/HEAD and GS-148 exclusive canonical ownership; carry this approved ED-D01 decision into a versioned `DECISION_LOG.md` entry on the isolated dashboard branch in a separately authorized documentation change, reconcile when canonical writer reaches safe checkpoint. Prior 2026-10-12 comments saying ED-D01 pending remain historical evidence, superseded by this dated decision only.

2026-10-12 UTC — isolated dashboard campaign checkpoint.

Branch feature/gs124-125-engineering-dashboard, worktree /home/udaybhan/projects/Ghar_sajag_r1_dashboard. Committed/pushed 31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2; actual git ls-remote equals local HEAD; tracked worktree clean. Baseline 77e29d44c57f0851f78358049c288323c985d2e7. Canonical GS-148 staged and unstaged fingerprints match intake; no canonical edits or merge. The user's campaign explicitly authorized this isolated branch and inactive preparation.

Completed the proposed v1 [implementation-ready architecture](https://github.com/udaybhan200683/Ghar_sajag/blob/31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2/docs/architecture/GS120_ENGINEERING_DASHBOARD_ARCHITECTURE.md): source/module audit, diagnostic versioning, original EventKey mapping/provenance, Node/contact/health distinctions, seven screen designs, exact-device installation transitions, observed/inferred fault diagnosis, authorization/redaction, resource/retention budgets, reuse plan and dependencies. [Interface/source inventory and decision register](https://github.com/udaybhan200683/Ghar_sajag/blob/31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2/docs/exec-plans/evidence/engineering_dashboard_20261012/README.md) are committed.

DESIGN PROPOSED / EXPLICIT ACCEPTANCE PENDING. Ordinary additive projection/UI details are distinguished from ED-D01–09 security, privacy/retention, installation policy, target-export and device-control decisions. None was self-approved. Node-local room:10:1 maps to qualified p6:devicen4:rooms10q1 with original session/sequence preserved; zero/untrusted target time cannot be fabricated as an optical timestamp.

User-authorized inactive preparation passes 45 model/API tests and 20 static-review browser checks; this is not production design acceptance. No production route, auth grant, command, persistence or second event pipeline was activated. Next: accept a named design subset and supply dependent verified technician/privacy/installation/export contracts. [Resume handoff](https://github.com/udaybhan200683/Ghar_sajag/blob/31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2/docs/exec-plans/evidence/engineering_dashboard_20261012/CAMPAIGN_HANDOFF.md). **GS-120 ED-D01 ARCHITECTURE APPROVED (READ-ONLY ONLY); LIVE PRODUCTION IMPLEMENTATION REMAINS BLOCKED_ED_D02_AUTH and other relevant pending contracts.** Approval is documented in GS-120 comment **10660**; detailed implementation source scope, isolation, handoff and stop conditions in GS-124 **10662** and GS-122 **10661**. **During implementation, bug fixing, simulation work, and ordinary feature/validation-framework tasks, DO NOT run** `make release-gate-final` or an unconditional full `make validation-fast`/full PWA-browser-backend campaign. Backend/PWA tests are required in the development loop only when their source, data model, or outward contract is affected. `release-gate-final` and the full product Node+Hub+integration+backend+PWA/browser suites must actually run at a genuine software/product release candidate, or upon separate explicit user request. A release/physical-qualification-specific ticket retains the exact dedicated acceptance tests it owns; this policy does not remove applicable physical/HIL, security/FOTA, or real backend/PWA contract acceptance. This is a validation-scope change, NOT a waiver of comprehensive regression coverage, a product-release approval, or permission to close a physically unverified ticket.

---

Only when design is approved.

# 2026-10-13 — PRODUCT-OWNER DECISION: ED-D02 APPROVED (HOME-SCOPED READ-DIAGNOSTICS POLICY)

**APPROVED POLICY DIRECTION, NOT A DELIVERED PRODUCTION AUTHENTICATION SYSTEM OR APPROVED CREDENTIAL TECHNOLOGY.** The product owner explicitly approved the proposed ED-D02 Home-scoped technician authorization policy in the current review. This updates the status of ED-D02 proposed contract in GS-143 comment **10665** from PROPOSED_FOR_APPROVAL to **APPROVED_POLICY / IMPLEMENTATION_PENDING**. Do not delete or rewrite 10665; it contains the full verified risk, threat, API/control and acceptance discussion. GS-120 ED-D01 architecture was separately approved in comment10660; GS-65 ED-D03-MIN privacy policy is approved in its own newly dated decision. No source, tokens, issuer, grant or real permission has been implemented or production-tested by Jira editing.

## 1. Binding approved access-control policy

1. **Explicit permission/deny-by-default.** `READ_DIAGNOSTICS` is a separately enumerated, least-privilege READ capability, never an alias of ordinary caregiver/family/Home READ. Unknown action names MUST fail closed. The observed implementation of `IdentityService.require` currently defaults unrecognized action to generic-read, hence invoking it with `READ_DIAGNOSTICS` without a correct enumerated authorization fix is **FORBIDDEN**. Internal `IdentityService.grant` must not be exposed as unauthenticated/public grant issuance.
2. **Verified production identity.** Authenticate and verify human actor independently at trusted server ingress, using GS-76 production identity/session authority; reject client-provided `actor_id`, `verified`, `is_technician`, arbitrary auth headers, QR/MAC, role/Home claims and test fixtures as authentication. Require valid trusted issuer+subject mapping, intended audience, expiry and session assurance. Actual provider, token/session/BFF choice and production issuer configuration are **NOT YET SELECTED/IMPLEMENTED** and require GS-76 qualified contract and deployment.
3. **Explicit current Home-scoped grant.** Being OWNER, CAREGIVER or INSTALLER alone does not confer technician access. A verified technician or explicitly delegated verified account may access one Home only after an explicit authorized, auditable `READ_DIAGNOSTICS` grant for that Home. Recommendation adopted at policy level: a **verified authorized Home Owner or separately authorized product administrator** is the candidate grantor; precise delegation service, OWNER self-grant policy, identity issuance and trusted authorizer need GS-143/GS-76 approved implementation decisions. No implicit owner/caregiver/installer grant or global superuser shortcut.
4. **Every request authorized at the source of data.** Server checks actor/session, active Home grant/membership, ownership epoch, device-to-Home binding, revocation/expiry/version and scoped query before selecting any row; validate exact event/trace joins, pagination, cursor, signed/current ownership context. Cross-Home result/existence leakage forbidden, including 404/403 resource enumeration, stale grant, race, transfer and recycled logical Node ID. Inactive/missing trust => 401/403/UNKNOWN, never broad read fallback.
5. **Revocation and client isolation.** Revoked/expired permission, changed Home ownership, logout or Home switch invalidates subsequent requests and pagination, aborts polling and clears Home-specific in-memory/UI state. No private diagnostics in service-worker, CacheStorage, localStorage, persistent browser offline or analytics/third-party telemetry. Denied attempts and authorized grant lifecycle receive sanitized, bounded audit evidence; storage/retention remains owned by approved privacy and GS-143 policy.
6. **Separated control plane.** ED-D02 grants read-only allowlisted metadata/trace permitted under ED-D03-MIN, not installation certification, remote Identify/Test/Restart/Recommission, arbitrary files/logs, export, user/admin management, Node claim, CloudSync authority or any write. Privileged ED-D07 remains OUT OF MVP/PENDING.

## 2. Explicitly NOT approved or delivered

* No production GS-76 IdP selection, trusted token issuer/verifier, deployed identity middleware, device/Hub credential issuer, verified tenant binding or complete audit infrastructure.
* No final numeric grant TTL, session refresh, maximum duration, time-of-day constraints, concrete grantor/self-grant UI/API, delegation and durable revocation implementation. These require explicit implementation-specific choices recorded by GS-76/143 and accepted by authorized product/security owner; no implicit constants.
* No authorization to change global `IdentityService` semantics outside appropriately reviewed GS-143 contract; implementation must preserve existing legitimate caregiver/admin behavior and add negative regressions.
* No production technician API/PWA activation until actual actor verification, grant issuance/revocation, current owner/Home source, cross-Home denies, request-layer and query-layer checks are implemented and independently executed. Fixture `verified` flags/test IDs are still not commercial trust.
* No GS-148/canonical storage changes, Node command, physical port/HIL, production merge or release qualification.

## 3. Required owner implementation and gate

**GS-76** choose/approve production identity issuer/session/verifier/deployment, exact trust and validity contract, implement source-backed ingress with negative spoof/expiry tests.
**GS-143** choose/approve grantor and expiry details, implement atomic explicit per-Home diagnostic authorization, deny-by-default action policy, versioned membership/ownership checks and revocation audit. Protect authorized writes and avoid unauthenticated `grant`.
**GS-124** only consume verified `authorize(actor,home,READ_DIAGNOSTICS,resource)` semantics, do not invent a production identity bypass. **GS-125** run actual GS-76/143/124 production-code negative tests and existing affected authorization/API/PWA/regression/HIL registry integrity.
**GS-109 / GS-148** own install/device identity/ownership and durable cloud trust decisions separately.

# 2026-10-13 — ED-D02 VERIFIED TECHNICIAN / HOME DIAGNOSTIC ACCESS — DETAILED CONTRACT FOR PRODUCT APPROVAL

**Disposition: PROPOSED_FOR_APPROVAL, NOT APPROVED, NOT IMPLEMENTED.** User instructed to advance the engineering dashboard after ED-D01 architecture approval (GS-120 comment 10660). This is the exact proposed security policy needed before GS-124 live routes. The user has NOT yet explicitly approved the specific ED-D02 grant issuer, delegation authority and security choices. GS-143 owns Home roles/membership/grants; GS-76 verified human authentication/deployment; GS-109 commercial installer/claim lifecycle; GS-124 consumes the resulting policy. No production route, grant, issuer, credential, Git or workflow mutation is authorized by this analysis.

## 1. SOURCE-VERIFIED BLOCKER / THREAT

Audited GS120 architecture commit `31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2` and GS109 commercial onboarding security audit record that `code/backend/ghar_sajag/identity.py` currently treats action `"manage"` specially and other action names as generic read. Therefore using `IdentityService.require(...,"READ_DIAGNOSTICS")` as-is risks automatically allowing OWNER/CAREGIVER/INSTALLER and leaking cross-household diagnostic/timeline/device data. `IdentityService.grant` is an INTERNAL helper and has no independently verified performer authorization; NEVER expose directly as a role-grant API. Current fixture `X-Actor-Id` / caller `verified` flags are not production human authentication.

## 2. PROPOSED SPECIFIC APPROVAL CHOICES (ED-D02)

**ED-D02-A — explicit permission:** Add a dedicated, typed allowlisted `READ_DIAGNOSTICS` action in the same authoritative role/policy engine. Unknown permissions MUST FAIL CLOSED. It grants only read-only metadata/diagnostic projection for one Home under ED-D03; not onboarding/manage/restart/recommission/export, arbitrary logs or historical resident records. Separate `INSTALLATION_OBSERVE` / `DEVICE_CONTROL` are NOT automatically granted and need their own future product decisions.

**ED-D02-B — independently verified actor:** Only GS-76 trusted human authenticator constructs the principal, keyed by verified (issuer,subject) mapped server-side to internal account and current Home membership; validate actual provider issuer, signature, audience, expiry, session and replay/CSRF boundaries. The concrete IdP, token/session/BFF format, expiry/refresh and production ingress are NOT yet chosen and remain GS-76 approvals/implementation. Do not accept identity, role, Home, grant, `verified` or physical QR/MAC from client-supplied fields, headers, app state or fixture middleware.

**ED-D02-C — explicit per-Home grant:** Neither OWNER nor CAREGIVER nor INSTALLER role alone implies `READ_DIAGNOSTICS`. Recommend Home OWNER or a separately authorized product administrator may grant/revoke a scoped, time-limited, auditable technician read authorization to a verified account (optionally themselves after authorized issuance); the issuer must be authorized by GS-143 before the first grant. No account gets diagnostic access by merely knowing Home ID, being a caregiver, or claiming technician. Device-access role and diagnostic-read grant remain distinct. Support only one Home at a time in browser scope; each request checks the exact current grant/membership, Home ownership epoch, revocation/version, target device belonging to same active Home, account/session validity, expiry and optional bounded purpose/site assignment. Numeric TTL and whether Home OWNER may self-grant need product selection; do not silently hardcode a nominal duration.

**ED-D02-D — defensive data access:** Server supplies effective `home_id` and authorized query scope, even if path contains a Home ID; enforce Home predicate at the storage/query layer, with secondary per-device/trace join fencing. Authorize BEFORE fetching foreign Home rows. No distinct foreign-Home existence hints; 401 unauthenticated, 403 denied/current grant missing, and Home-scoped 404 for inaccessible/unknown device/event. Forbidden/expired/invalid grant rejects ALL diagnostic views including overview, trace, events, devices, communication and future installation results. Query cursor and cache embed opaque Home+grant/owner epoch and fail closed on transfer/revocation; never trust hidden frontend controls as a security boundary.

**ED-D02-E — revocation/session changes:** Check current grant on EVERY request and each paginated continuation/export. Home transfer, membership change, revoked/expired grant, actor logout or Home switch stops polling, clears browser in-memory state and any service-worker/private cache, invalidates cursors and fails closed; do not continue with old in-flight results. No diagnostic data in shared/offline/public service worker cache, localStorage, analytics or prefetch for a different account/Home. Audit grant issue/extend/revoke, access decision, role and ownership change with actor/action/Home/UTC/outcome and correlation ID, not secrets or raw household event payloads. The durability/retention of the audit ledger requires GS-143 / ED-D03 decisions.

**ED-D02-F — delivery boundary:** Keep engineering PWA isolated behind verified technician route guard and server-side action checks, including negative tests for ordinary owner/caregiver without explicit grant; no privileged POST in initial read-only MVP. HTTP security protections: TLS, no unsafe CORS wildcard, typed input validation, bounded rate/pagination, content-security-safe rendering, denial audit, CSRF on any later session-changing POST. Development/test principal adapter may be used ONLY in clearly test-only injected fixture, never production composition.

## 3. Candidate policy matrix (subject to approval)

| Principal / state | Diagnostic GET | Install observe/mutate | Recommission/restart |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unauthenticated | DENY | DENY | DENY |
| Ordinary Caregiver, no grant | DENY | DENY | DENY |
| Home OWNER, no explicit diagnostic grant | DENY | DENY | DENY |
| Installer role, no explicit diagnostic grant | DENY | DENY | DENY |
| Verified actor with current explicit Home READ_DIAGNOSTICS | ALLOW limited ED-D03 fields for that Home only | DENY absent future INSTALLATION_OBSERVE | DENY |
| Any actor: expired/revoked grant, wrong Home, stale ownership epoch, transferred Hub | DENY | DENY | DENY |
| Local fixture forged `X-Actor-Id` / `verified=True` | DENY in production | DENY | DENY |

## 4. Proposed module ownership (NOT approval to implement)

* GS-76: verified actor/session construction and production deployment, `code/backend/ghar_sajag/http_api.py` ingress; candidate `actor_authentication.py`.
* GS-143: exhaustive action policy and audited per-Home delegated grant authorizer; existing `identity.py`, `homes.py`, appropriate durable membership model/migration through approved GS-143 scope (not exposed `IdentityService.grant`).

# 2026-10-13 — PRODUCT-OWNER DECISION: ED-D03-MIN APPROVED (PRIVACY-MINIMAL READ-ONLY DIAGNOSTICS)

**ED-D03-MIN=APPROVED_POLICY; IMPLEMENTATION/VALIDATION PENDING.** Product owner explicitly approved the proposed ED-D03-MIN privacy policy for Ghar Sajag R1. The exact comprehensive prior proposal is GS-65 comment **10666**; this dated decision supersedes only its PROPOSED_FOR_APPROVAL status. ED-D01 bounded read-only architecture approved (GS-120 comment10660); ED-D02 Home-scoped `READ_DIAGNOSTICS` policy separately approved under GS-143. This does NOT approve broad diagnostic history retention, export, installation certificates, physical tests, production auth issuer, device commands, new Hub storage, cloud authority or unmeasured resource budgets.

## 1. Approved minimum exposure classes

**Class A — verified current Home-scoped health/technical summary (read permission required):** authenticated device/Hub connectivity state, NodeHealth age and authenticated contact age as different observations, firmware/config fingerprint if trustworthy, measured directional RSSI and actual verified battery data where available, last backed evidence freshness, bounded queue depth/oldest age if directly observed, last real backend synchronization/health, non-secret diagnostic reason codes, uncertainty and omission/drop indicators. Unknown, missing, unsupported or stale measurement MUST be rendered UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED/STALE, not zero/HEALTHY/fully delivered.

**Class B — narrow single-event Home-scoped troubleshooting trace only:** original EventKey as exact string plus verified original Home, physical/logical Node and generation, qualified zone/room and event category, distinct occurrence/receive/commit timestamps with trust/uncertainty, explicit TX/RX/Hub admission/local durable-app ACK/backend COMMITTED/PWA observation **where each stage independently evidenced**, duplicate/retry and redacted error/provenance. Trace requires the same valid explicit Home-scoped `READ_DIAGNOSTICS` grant and server-side exact requested event/trace access, bounded recent window, no arbitrary household timeline browsing and sanitized audit. A future separate HISTORICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_TRACE or export permission is NOT part of MVP. Do not infer optical PIR evidence from backend row; real target stage stays UNKNOWN without actual exporter.

**Always excluded:** resident names/identities, medication/health details, phone/email/full home address, raw event payload/event media, arbitrary raw firmware/network logs, customer narrative/history exports, installer proof, tokens/cookies/passwords, QR secrets, keys/wrapping/ECDH materials, unbounded event streams, cross-Home global views, unsafe exception text, third-party analytics and telemetry. Presence in production product DB does not itself entitle diagnostics exposure.

## 2. Approved storage, browser and operational posture

* **No new on-Node/S3 persistent diagnostic journal or Node wake/radio change; no duplicate backend product-event table; no new diagnostic data authority.** Read existing owned source via bounded projection; GS-148 event storage/cloud/receipt/GC untouched.
* **Ephemeral, bounded server-side observations and frontend memory only**; no new persistent diagnostic history, long-term install PASS certificate, CSV/PDF/raw log export or background analytics in this MVP. Existing original product-event retention remains under the existing product authority; this decision doesn't erase/alter it. If source cannot provide a field, show unavailable.
* **No private diagnostic response caching** in service worker, CacheStorage, localStorage or IndexedDB; diagnostic response `Cache-Control: no-store`; clear state and reject cached cursors on logout/revocation/Home switch/ownership epoch change; bounded per-Home pagination and rate/bytes. Future tenant export remains separate approval.
* **Sanitized access/grant audit metadata only**: actor reference, Home reference, action, decision/outcome, UTC/correlation ID, safe category — no raw EventKeys+activity payload in generic logs. Final audit ledger storage, numeric retention and any legal deletion/consent workflow remain GS-143/product implementation choices. They are not silently assigned by ED-D03-MIN.
* **Budget candidates not locked**: 100/page, 256 recent observations, 512 encoded bytes and 5-second polling in GS-120 remain preliminary calculations, subject to measurement/rate/resource/security review. Use smallest genuinely sufficient bounded defaults after an approved specific performance policy, never treat audit estimates as product acceptance.

## 3. Acceptance requirements before active production use

(a) Independently verified ED-D02 current Home grant gates each request/trace/query/join and forbids cross-Home enumeration including stale cursor; (b) Class A/limited B allowlist with schema rejection of `raw`/`columns`/`include_payload` and content sanitization; (c) secrets, personal data and full raw event not present in API/UI/access logs; (d) no browser/pwa persistent/private cache and effective cancellation/clear on revoked grant, Home switch and logout; (e) incomplete source evidence UNKNOWN not fake PASS; (f) actual enforced pagination/rate/bytes and drop/gap behavior; (g) tests prove no new firmware wake or durable storage writer or effect on Node/Hub ACK/replay/GS-148; (h) actual production auth/API/Playwright and GS-116/130 affected regression+permanent registration PASS. Use existing GS-125 test matrix, not a separate framework.

## 4. Explicit outstanding execution choices

`ED-D03-MIN` approves **data minimization and ephemeral default**, not a numerical server/history/audit retention duration, grant TTL, special consent UX, cross-region retention, schema indexes, or commercial compliance certification. ED-D04 installer required-stage+PASS policy and retained certificate remain separate. ED-D05 target export, ED-D06 physical fixture, ED-D07 privileged commands, ED-D08 CloudSync, ED-D09 canonical merge remain separately pending/deferred. As long as GS-76/143 verified production identity grants and ED-D03 enforcement are unimplemented, GS-124 live technician routes remain **BLOCKED_PRODUCTION_AUTH_AND_PRIVACY_ENFORCEMENT**.

**Disposition:** `ED-D03-MIN=APPROVED_POLICY; PRIVACY_ENFORCEMENT=NOT_IMPLEMENTED/NOT_QUALIFIED; NO_PRODUCTION_ACTIVATION`. GS-65 workflow remains To Do. No Jira approval can be read as a production security test PASS.

# 2026-10-13 — ED-D03-MIN ENGINEERING DIAGNOSTICS PRIVACY / RETENTION: RECOMMENDED REVIEW CONTRACT

**DISPOSITION: PROPOSED_FOR_APPROVAL (NOT APPROVED).** GS-120 ED-D01 read-only design approved in comment10660. This proposal defines the smallest diagnostic data-exposure contract that could allow an authenticated read-only GS-124 initial release after independent ED-D02 approval. It DOES NOT authorize actual new routes, field access, persistent logging, export or installation certification. GS-65 is diagnostics interface owner; product/privacy and GS-143/109 own consent/role/grant policy; GS-148 owns original durable product records.

## 1. Fundamental minimization decision

**Recommended ED-D03-MIN:** No new Node/S3 persistent diagnostic journal, no duplicate backend product-event table, no new persisted/redistributed resident timeline, no service-worker/offline technician cache, no unrestricted log endpoint, no diagnostic CSV/PDF export, no persistent installation certificate and no privileged technician mutation in R1 read-only MVP. Engineering diagnostics is a bounded, read-only, server-authorized ephemeral projection of already permitted Home-owned records and available observed health. Original product retention remains controlled by its existing authority; removing a diagnostic projection does NOT erase authentic product records.

## 2. Proposed field-level allowlist / visibility

**Class A — default authenticated Home diagnostic metadata (only after explicit READ_DIAGNOSTICS):** source-labeled Hub/Node active/unknown/offline state, firmware/config fingerprint only if authenticated, last authenticated radio contact and NodeHealth time/age as distinct signals, directional RSSI if measured, battery/health values only if verified/qualified, backend network/cloud availability, stage availability status, diagnostic reason codes, queue count/age where real and freshness, bounded counts and gap/drop notices. Unsupported/unmeasured values report UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED/STALE, never zero or nominal values.

**Class B — event-specific diagnostic trace (same explicit Home grant, narrowly requested):** stable opaque event_id and original EventKey represented as exact strings, physical/logical Node and enrollment generation when independently verified, approved room/zone assignment, event type, trusted original time with uncertainty separately from receive/commit time, duplicate/retry and app ACK vs backend COMMITTED stage status, sanitized evidence provenance. Use a bounded page, exact event requested or defined narrow diagnostic window, and Home predicate on every join. This metadata is sensitive (room/time activity patterns): authorize against same Home with server-side allowlist and audit; do not expose resident/person identity or replay entire household raw event history. Whether Class B requires a SECOND trace-specific delegated action versus current READ_DIAGNOSTICS is an open privacy choice; conservative recommendation is explicit separate trace capability for broad history, with single-event troubleshooting under a narrowed grant.

**Class C — always excluded from ordinary diagnostics:** PINs, Wi-Fi passwords, tokens/session cookies, private or wrapping/signing keys, QR installer secrets, ECDH materials, raw packets, raw identity proof bytes, patient/medicine data, telephone numbers, email/home street address, resident names, exact private personal health information, raw sensor/media, complete unbounded event payloads and resident routines. No attacker-input/raw exception string interpolation or PII in audit/error codes. Support personnel should not see material merely because it exists in debug logs.

**Class D — privileged/retained/export:** installation certificates, full diagnostic event history, raw log archives, tenant-wide cross-Home dashboards, export/download, technician support uploads, always-on remote telemetry and customer analytics remain **OUT OF MVP / separate ED-D03-FULL approval**. No silent fallback to weaker authorization to keep a UI responsive.

## 3. Data lifetime / capacity / transfer / deletion policy candidates

* First R1 implementation uses **server-side bounded ephemeral observation window and short-lived frontend in-memory state** only. Do not write new durable diagnostic records to Hub NVS/LittleFS/gs_outbox or Node flash. Existing original durable event retention is unchanged. Only existing Home-filtered persistent product DB queries may be read; do not replicate them to an additional diagnostic log.
* Service worker / CacheStorage / localStorage / IndexedDB must not persist technician diagnostic payload, grants, original EventKeys or cross-Home timeline. No diagnostic analytics/third-party telemetry; no PWA prefetch beyond current authorized Home. On logout, revoke, Home switch, ownership epoch change or token expiry, stop polling/abort requests and clear UI state/cursors. Response privacy cache headers: `Cache-Control: no-store` for all diagnostic API responses, and proper server-side no-cache behavior.
* Single-Home, max-results and rate constraints always enforced in backend. GS-120 examples **100 rows/page, 256 recent observations, 512-byte encoded target**, 5-second polling are **CANDIDATES**, not approved fixed release limits. Derive actual budget after ED-D05 and target measurement. Default to no persistent diagnostic history; if RAM pressure occurs drop oldest observations with visible gap indicator rather than blocking P0.
* Server audit records only actor reference, Home reference, action, source, decision/outcome, time, correlation ID and denial reason category — no household activity content, tokens or event payload. Audit log durability, legal/privacy retention and authorized support export require GS-143/product policy; do NOT quietly invent a storage lifetime.
* Privacy withdrawal / Home transfer revokes view and invalidates cursors immediately; never relabel stale old Home event keys as new Home. Deletion obligations for the original product timeline are governed by product authority, **not** implemented in dashboard MVP.
* Browser screenshots cannot be technically prevented; keep data deliberately minimal, supply notice to authorized technician and allow Home owner to end session. Never promise automatic deletion of copies outside supported control.

## 4. Precise UX/API requirements

* Every view shows current Home association, source freshness and limits; diagnostics for missing target evidence explicitly UNKNOWN.
* Room name and exact event time are only rendered when Class B is allowed by approved policy; otherwise show an appropriately redacted/unavailable representation.
* Logs: allowed reason code + safe next diagnostic step; no free-form raw firmware traces in normal UI. Hide literal secrets in exception strings and URLs.
* All server query paths: authentication and Home permission check BEFORE retrieving rows, with backend projection allowlist and bounded filters; schema rejects unexpected fields. Even under READ_DIAGNOSTICS one cannot request arbitrary `columns`, `raw=1` or `include_payload`.
* Open source provenance/diagnostic counters must not become a new source of Home ownership authority, medical claims or a caregiver safety assessment.
* Future installation result storage is ED-D04 plus ED-D03-FULL: decide accepted evidence, session audit, lifetime, consent, delete/export and authorization before any persisted PASS certificate.

## 5. ED-D03-MIN acceptance evidence (after approved + implemented)

1. Default GET permitted only under ED-D02 verified specific Home grant and returns only Class A plus narrowly authorized Class B fields.
2. Independent cross-Home actor/device/EventKey enumeration and cursor attacks reveal neither data nor existence.
3. Diagnostic responses have proper no-store and frontend/service-worker does not cache personal/technical telemetry; Home switch/logout/revoke clears state.
4. Sensitive raw keys, credentials, installer tokens, resident names, telephone/address, event payload and original raw logs are absent from responses/logs/screens and redaction tests cover failures.
5. Error and slow/failing backend paths don't leak other Home or stale event details; UNKNOWN not presumed PASS.
6. Byte/row/time/rate limits actually enforce on backend; overflow creates bounded gap status without impacting event ACK, safety rules, flash pressure or cloud reliability.
7. No new Node wake/radio packet, S3 durable schema, backend duplicate product-event store or unrestricted retained diagnostic stream; verify source diffs and memory/bandwidth in relevant affected-component tests.
8. Data exposure, cache clearing, permission denial, safe escaping and browsing validated with GS-125 actual production-code unit/backend/Playwright and GS-116/130 regression registry after activation; review-only static browser tests do not count.

## 6. Approval points and dependencies

**Decision requested: ED-D03-MIN** = field Class A plus narrow audited Class B; no new diagnostic durable storage/export/installation certificate; approved bounded ephemeral server/browser memory; no raw resident/secret data and explicit no-store. This is the recommended low-risk MVP. Exact retention, role-grant TTL, wide historical browsing, trace-specific subpermission and diagnostic audit retention are unselected; keep them PENDING where needed, do not invent.

ED-D02 must approve verified actor/Home grant first; ED-D04 installer PASS/timeout, ED-D05 target telemetry and ED-D08 production cloud remain independent. No commercial launch until mandatory production contracts/qualification pass. See GS-143 ED-D02 proposed detailed contract **comment10665**, GS-120 ED-D01 **10660**, GS-122 original handoff **10661**.

**NO PRODUCT DECISION RECORDED HERE**. User approval must name ED-D03-MIN (or exact alternative); only then is a matching versioned canonical product/decision entry authorized on a separately owned branch after GS-148 writer reconciliation.

GS-65 remains separate owner of trustworthy diagnostics/provenance and any target observation export; approval DOES NOT authorize new Hub radio/flash/CloudSync writers, privileged control endpoints, raw secret/credential logging, production technician grants or physical HIL. Required pending contracts: ED-D02 trusted explicit Home-scoped `READ_DIAGNOSTICS` with GS-109/143, ED-D03 privacy/retention, ED-D04 installer evidence policy, ED-D05 authenticated Node/Hub observation export/budget with GS-148, ED-D06 actual fixture safety, ED-D07 privileged commands deferred, ED-D08 deployed CloudSync, ED-D09 canonical merge/source reconciliation. Unknown target stages must remain UNKNOWN rather than fabricated PASS; existing sensor/Hub/ACK pipeline unchanged. Reference source commit 31822b1a6bd1a7fc11e00fb63805eb5110e444b2 GS120_ENGINEERING_DASHBOARD_ARCHITECTURE.md. No issue workflow/status change.
